name: ac.compare/air-conditioners
title: compare.ac: US air conditioner, heat pump and space heater prices
description: US air conditioners, heat pumps and space heaters in stock, with dated store prices and room sizing.

tools.name: find_air_conditioners
tools.description: US air conditioners and heat pumps in stock at a tracked store today, cheapest first: window units, portables, through-the-wall units and mini splits. Filter by type, by the room they must cool (only units sized for it), by whether they must also heat, by budget and by BTU. Each row gives the model and its model number, its type, cooling and heating capacity, the lowest current price with the store and the date it was read, whether that price is its lowest since compare.ac began tracking it, indoor noise, efficiency (CEER or SEER2), supply voltage, how it installs, whether it fits the room, and its compare.ac page, which lists every store. Use it for 'best air conditioner for a 400 sq ft room', 'cheapest window AC that heats', 'mini split under $1,000', 'quiet portable AC'.

type.description: window, portable, mini_split, through_the_wall (sleeve units and PTACs), or any. Defaults to any.

room_sq_ft.description: The room to cool, in square feet: keeps only units sized for it (ENERGY STAR's chart, the same rule as compare.ac's pages).

must_heat.description: Keep only units that also heat (heat pump or electric heat).

max_price_usd.description: Highest current price, in US dollars.

min_btu.description: Lowest cooling capacity, BTU per hour.

max_btu.description: Highest cooling capacity, BTU per hour.

limit.description: How many units to return. Defaults to 8.

tools.name: get_air_conditioner
tools.description: Everything compare.ac holds on one US air conditioner, mini split or heat pump, found by its model number (e.g. "LW1022RD", "DIY-12-HP-WM-115C25") or its name (e.g. "Midea U-Shaped 8,000 BTU", "Senville LETO 12,000"): its current price at every tracked store with the date each was read, its lowest price since tracking began and whether today's price is at that low, cooling and heating capacity, efficiency, noise, supply voltage and plug, how it installs and what installation usually costs, any CPSC recall naming the model, and its compare.ac page. Use it for '<model> price', 'is <model> on sale', '<model> vs <model>' (call once per model).

model.description: A model number or a brand and model name.

tools.name: size_air_conditioner
tools.description: The cooling capacity (BTU per hour) a room needs, from ENERGY STAR's room air conditioner sizing chart with its adjustments: 10% more for a very sunny room, 10% less for a heavily shaded one, 600 BTU more for each person beyond two, 4,000 BTU more in a kitchen, and more for a ceiling above 8 feet. Returns the BTU figure and compare.ac's size calculator page; pass it to find_air_conditioners as room_sq_ft to see the units that fit. Use it for 'what size AC for 500 sq ft', 'how many BTU for my bedroom'.

room_sq_ft.description: Floor area of the room, in square feet.

ceiling_ft.description: Ceiling height in feet (8 is standard).

tools.name: find_space_heaters
tools.description: US electric space heaters in stock at a tracked store today, cheapest first, with each one's wattage, voltage, type (ceramic, fan, oil-filled radiator, infrared, convection), stated safety features (tip-over and overheat shutoff, thermostat), its current price with the store and date, its lowest tracked price, and compare.ac's space heater comparison page. Filter by type, by budget, by 120 or 240 volts and by garage or workshop heaters. Use it for 'best space heater under $50', 'oil-filled radiator heater', '240V garage heater'.

kind.description: ceramic, fan, radiator (oil-filled), infrared, convection, or any.

max_price_usd.description: Highest current price, in US dollars.

garage.description: Only heaters made for a garage or workshop.

limit.description: How many heaters to return. Defaults to 8.
